stemMd: Assuming complete dissociation and negligible water autoionisation, what is the pH of 0.001 mol/L hydrochloric acid?
explanationMd: For a strong monoprotic acid, hydrogen-ion concentration is 10 to the minus three mol/L. Taking its negative base-ten logarithm gives pH 3.

distractorRationale.e: This corresponds to 0.1 mol/L hydrogen ions.
distractorRationale.d: This is the corresponding pOH at 25 degrees Celsius.
distractorRationale.a: pH is logarithmic, not the concentration itself.
distractorRationale.b: The negative logarithm of 10 to the minus three is positive three.
